page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped directly to 16 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is provisioned with 16.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. It runs on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. There are zero integrated graphics processing units and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included in the base configuration.

With a one-to-one ratio of vCPUs to memory, the ecs.c2.medium is designed for compute-bound workloads that do not require large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. This profile is suitable for batch processing, high-performance web serving, and compute-heavy microservices, though the lack of local storage and low memory-to-core ratio represents a tradeoff for database or memory-intensive applications.
